utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: If you still have them, yes, I could use the screws. Thank you, Oren—that would make things a little easier.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh! Yes, I’ve still got them — I’ll bring the spare screws by this afternoon, Uli. Thanks for being patient with me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Oren. I’ll be here this afternoon, and I appreciate it more than I can say.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in—Mara’s lining up volunteers and the repair list for you, with the alley fence first. I can handle tool sorting and pickups, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a huge help, Leo—thank you. I’ve got us shifted to Sunday at the community center, so please go ahead with tool sorting and pickups while Mara pulls the volunteer and repair list together, starting with the alley fence.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—I’ll sort tools and handle pickups for Sunday at the community center. We still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves covered.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye — quick version is I’ve got the drill, extension cord, and spare screws covered, but I’m still waiting on Rosa’s list for who needs what fixed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — 10 still works best for me around school drop-off and pickup, so just send Rosa’s list when you get it and I’ll plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — plan on 10, and I’ll pass Rosa’s list along as soon as it lands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it’d help a lot if you can spread the word—I’m bringing my toolbox and a couple spare clamps, and I’m still waiting on the full parts list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That helps a ton, Gus—I've already got screws covered, and right now we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good to know—I'll ask around for duct tape and work gloves, and I’ve still got the toolbox and clamps covered.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Mara, let’s keep it simple: first we fix the porch steps on Maple, then the garden-lot fence, and I’ve got duct tape plus two pairs of work gloves on the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it — I’ll pass Rosa the priority order and add the duct tape plus two pairs of work gloves to the list, then I’ll keep asking around for any other repair items or volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds right, Mara—once Rosa has the order and supply list, let’s see what else is still missing before we spread the word any wider.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, we’re getting there—screws are covered, but we still still need duct tape, a couple pairs of work gloves, and a few more hands if Pia knows anyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to check with the organizers before I promise anyone, but I can pass along that duct tape, work gloves, and a few more volunteers are still needed. Can they also confirm the latest sign-up count, which houses still need fixes, and the drop-off window?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be perfect, Pia—please pass that along, and I’ll check back with the organizers on the sign-up count, which houses still need fixes, and the drop-off window so I can tell folks the latest.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’m heading down Cedar and Pine now, and I’ll circle back soon so we can compare who’s heard.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good—I’ll keep tracking the sign-ups here, and when you circle back from Cedar and Pine we’ll compare notes house by house.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—I’ll move quick on Cedar and Pine and come right back so we can match up house by house.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m pretty sure we’re still aiming for around 10 for the repair drive, and I think duct tape plus a couple pairs of work gloves are the main things still needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — before I act on that, can you confirm the latest firm sign-up count and which houses still still need repairs, including whether the Patel house is already marked finished?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I don’t have the firm count in front of me, and I’m not sure on the Patel house—I’d want to check with Cleo before I tell you wrong.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I only know a little so far, but I heard the porch steps on Maple should come first. If you want, I can make a simple list so people know what tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d help a lot—please make the list, and I’ll start spreading the word and asking around for anyone who knows bikes or small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Alright—I’ll keep it simple: porch steps on Maple first, then the garden lot fence, and lamp rewiring still needs a volunteer. If Gus can match tools to that, it should help folks know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m letting people know the repair drive’s coming together, Dane, and that we’ve got some tools lined up but could still use more steady hands.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—where do you need me first, and which fixes still need extra hands?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Glad you made it, Dane—jump in where the small-appliance fixes are, since that’s where we still need the most steady hands right now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules—that helps a lot. I’m still out on errands, so send me a quick update once you hear back from folks on your side.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do—I’m checking with a few neighbors now, and I’ll send you a quick update once I know who can come and whether anyone can bring the gloves or duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—thanks, Jules. I’m still out running errands, so just send me whatever you hear and I’ll keep things coordinated from here.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still only have second-hand bits, so I shouldn’t guess—I’ll confirm the sign-up list today and ask Raj and Elena exactly what tools they’ve committed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—when you check, send me the actual volunteer names and confirm whether Raj and Elena are definite on tools, not maybes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely—I’ll send you the actual names, the volunteer count, and exactly what Raj and Elena confirm they’re bringing once I’ve checked today.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m pulling people together from my side, and Noah’s still thinking around 10. We could also use duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves if Kira knows anyone who can bring them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm who’s actually committed so far and whether Noah’s definitely in by 10? If that’s settled, I can ask around for duct tape and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: So far I’ve got a few neighbors lined up to bring tools and extra hands, but Noah only said he’s thinking around 10, not fully confirmed yet. If you ask around for duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves now, I’ll keep pinning down the final headcount and timing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that makes sense — Maple porch steps first, then the garden fence, and we can note the tools and parts for each so people come ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds right, but let’s confirm the current sign-up count and which houses still need fixes with Rosa or Hana before we send anyone out. Once that’s settled, I want to make sure you know exactly where to go and who to check in with.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay — if you check with Rosa or Hana on the sign-ups and houses, I can write down the list and then just go where you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing, and should I start with outreach or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still waiting on Rosa’s house list, so start with outreach for now and tell folks we’ve got the drill, extension cord, and screws covered. Once the list lands, we’ll sort who needs fixes and who can bring what.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ll start spreading the word and let folks know the drill, extension cord, and screws are already covered.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard second-hand that a few people signed up, and I think Raj and maybe Elena are bringing tools, but we should really confirm with the organizer.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still tracking duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves on my list, Nell, and I’d like to confirm who’s actually bringing tools before we count on that.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, same here—I only heard Raj and maybe Elena mentioned for tools, so I wouldn’t count on it until the organizer confirms who's actually committed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, I’m spreading the word fast for the repair drive—can I count you in, and should I let the rest of your side know too?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, absolutely—please let them know I’ve got the folding tables, and unless someone’s stepped up, we still need a volunteer for the lamp rewiring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll spread the word on your side and let everyone know you’ve got the folding tables—we’re still looking for someone to handle the lamp rewiring too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Faye, I’m tracking Maple closely—12, 18, and 27 are already covered, and I’m checking the rest of Maple plus the corner apartments for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal—that’s really helpful. I’m still good for 10, as long as I can slip back out in time for school pickup if we run long.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—that gives me a clear anchor, so I’ll mark you for 10 and keep the route tight around Maple so you can get out on time for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Noah—what’s the first thing that still needs a hand, and do we already know the tool drop-off window?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think the first gap is still duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves, and I’m planning on around 10 for the drop-off unless someone needs a slight shift.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—if 10 still works, I can help chase down the duct tape and gloves first. Anything else I should grab while I’m at it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s coming together, slowly. If you keep pointing people our way for steady hands, that helps more than anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Uli—I’ll keep telling folks the repair drive’s coming together and that what you need most right now is steady hands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. That kind of quiet help keeps it moving, and I’m grateful for it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’m still planning to bring my toolbox and a couple spare clamps; if you’ve heard who still needs parts, that’d help us sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus—that’ll help a lot. I’m still out on errands, but keep me posted on who still needs parts and I’ll help sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do — as soon as I hear who still needs parts, I’ll pass it along so we can match up what folks are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—send Rosa whatever you gather, and I’ll focus on picking up duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good—I’ll line up volunteers and a repair list for Rosa, with the alley fence first on the list, and I’ll send it over as I gather names.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—once you send Rosa the list, text me if any pickups besides the duct tape and gloves come up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Tess, the plainest version is this: folks can bring things that need fixing, and we still need duct tape and two pairs of work gloves for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Eli—I’ll spread the word that folks can bring repairs by, and that we’re still short on duct tape and two pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess—that keeps it nice and clear. If anyone asks, we’ll start with the porch steps on Maple, then the fence by the garden lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mina — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m still firming up who’s fully committed and which tools are definitely covered. If you’ve got any repair needs or know someone who can lend tools, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Rosa, how many homes are actually signed up so far, and who’s confirmed for the lamp rewiring and tool coverage?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m still confirming the final list, Mina, so I can’t give you a firm count or promise lamp rewiring and tool coverage just yet — if you’ve heard who’s definitely in, send them my way and I’ll lock it down.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard second-hand that they’re collecting money for parts and borrowing tools for the day, but I’m still not clear on who’s definitely committed. We should check with the organizer before we count on anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Good call — Rosa’s pulling the list together, and I told her I’d ask around this afternoon and send over any volunteers or repair items I find. I’m still in, and I’ll confirm who’s definitely committed before we count on them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps—I’ve only heard scattered bits, so if Rosa’s got the list going, let’s wait on her before we say tools or volunteers are covered for sure.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Vik, I’m spreading invitations quickly for the repair drive—can I count you in, and should I let the rest of your side of the block know too?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—count me in, and let folks on my side know the repair drive’s coming together with tools and extra hands, but we could still use more steady help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Vik—I’ll spread that along your side right away and let everyone know we’ve got tools and extra hands, but we’re still looking for more steady help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Gus—what’s the first thing that still needs a hand for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — first thing is sorting who still needs what parts, and after that I can bring my toolbox and a couple spare clamps to help with the fixes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I can start sorting the parts list now, then jump in with the fixes once you bring the toolbox and clamps.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—bring the duct tape and gloves if you can, and we’ll sort the first pickups at the shed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, duct tape and gloves, got it. I’m heading to the community shed now, Leo, so I should be there before I forget anything else.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—I'll meet you there and get the tool pile organized so we can start as soon as you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hana, can you confirm who’s actually committed so far and whether the tools are definitely lined up, or is it still being firmed up?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It’s still being firmed up—I need the latest confirmed sign-up count, which houses still need fixes, and what tools we actually have on hand before I can confirm anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, that’s what I needed to know—so nothing’s confirmed yet. Let me know once you’ve got the actual sign-ups, houses, and tools pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can still do 10 for the repair drive, as long as we keep it fairly tight around school pickup and drop-off—have you heard anything more from the organizer?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven’t heard anything new from the organizer yet, but on supplies I’ve got screws covered and we still need duct tape plus a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks—that helps. I’m still good for 10 if it stays tight around the school run, and I can bring duct tape unless you hear otherwise from the organizer.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Opal, besides Maple 12, 18, and 27, which addresses are confirmed signed up right now, and who’s definitely handling lamp rewiring if Quinn still hasn’t checked back?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I only have Maple confirmed right now—12, 18, and 27—and I’m still tracking the rest of Maple plus the corner apartments. I haven’t heard a definite yes on lamp rewiring yet if Quinn still hasn’t checked back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Then I need the next concrete update: when will you have confirmed addresses beyond Maple 12, 18, and 27, and who are you checking with first on the lamp rewiring?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Before we promise anything, can we get the latest sign-up count and confirm the drop-off window, plus whether tool intake or setup still needs covering?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still waiting on the latest list, so I’d check with Rosa or Gus for the sign-up count and drop-off window. I’ve got tool intake on my radar, but I can’t promise setup coverage yet.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, let’s wait for Rosa’s updated list before we lock anything in, and please let me know as soon as you hear whether setup still needs covering.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing, and should I start with outreach or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Sam—I’m still out on errands, so please start with outreach and keep me posted on what the repair drive still needs.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it—I’ll start with outreach around the block and let you know what we still need, especially any repair volunteers or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay, let’s keep it simple then: porch steps on Maple first, fence by the garden lot after, and the lamp rewiring clearly marked since nobody’s taken it yet.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a clear order, Rey; I’ll repeat it that way when folks ask. We still need duct tape and two pairs of work gloves, and the lamp rewiring should stay clearly marked as unclaimed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Alright, I’ll keep it written that way, and I’ll add duct tape and two pairs of work gloves under supplies. The lamp rewiring stays marked unclaimed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, I’m still thinking around 10 for the repair drive, if that works for Uli, and I think duct tape plus a couple pairs of work gloves are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds about right to me—ten should help, and the tape and gloves would still be useful. Tess has the clearest count, though, if you want the latest.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good—then let’s keep it at 10 for now, and I’ll check with Tess so I’m not missing anything on the tape and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Rosa, from what I’ve got so far, screws are covered and Uli says he can bring some tools later, but we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — I’ve got screws noted, and I’ll treat Uli’s tools as tentative until he confirms; we still need duct tape and two pairs of work gloves for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That matches what I’ve been hearing, Rosa—if you want, I’ll keep spreading the word that duct tape and two pairs of work gloves are still the big gaps for Sunday.
